name: rows
title: Plant Rows
subtitle: Canopy cover and row geometry for row-sown stands
description: Canopy cover, detected row count, mean row spacing and plants per row for plants grown in rows. One summary row per image.
method: ExG = 2G - R - B (Woebbecke et al. 1995) computed in 32-bit so the subtraction is not clipped, Otsu threshold, despeckle. Row centres from the horizontal projection profile of the mask, taking contiguous runs above 20% of the profile maximum as rows.
dataType: overhead images of plants sown in rows

outputs.name: CanopyCover
outputs.label: Canopy cover
outputs.description: Percentage of image area classified as vegetation

outputs.name: RowCount
outputs.label: Rows detected
outputs.description: Number of rows found in the projection profile

outputs.name: RowSpacing
outputs.label: Mean row spacing
outputs.description: Mean distance between adjacent row centres

outputs.name: PlantsPerRow
outputs.label: Plants per row
outputs.description: Plant clusters divided by row count

commonColumns.Label: Source image title
commonColumns.Unit: Spatial unit of every length/area column
commonColumns.Calibrated: 1 if a scale was applied; 0 means all values are in pixels
